faq: Who can join SELYVO Market?
Businesses and freelancers invited by a member. Ask a customer or supplier who is on SELYVO to invite you. If you do not know anyone on SELYVO yet, write to us.
How does SELYVO know a business is real?
Each company is found in its business register, checked against sanctions lists and qualified with SELYVO’s questions before it can trade. Customers’ reviews follow its orders.
What does it cost?
SELYVO’s fees are paid from a prepaid budget as they fall due. You add funds by card or bank transfer and see every charge in your account.
Does it work with our accounting?
Invoices carry VAT by country and the wording each case requires, and they print or save as PDF. Invoices made in your own accounting can be sent through SELYVO from a file.
Is there a phone app?
SELYVO works in the browser on a computer, a tablet or a phone. Every screen adapts to a phone.

Invite it. Once it has joined, it can order from you and receive your invoices on SELYVO.
How do requests reach me?
Requests published in your categories and countries appear in Sales. A buyer can also invite you by name.

hero.title: Every order, from accepted to paid, in one place.

Ordered, accepted, delivered, received, invoiced, paid: customer and supplier see the same steps and dates.
Deliveries in parts
Each delivery has its delivery note. The customer confirms what arrived, and the rest stays open.
Messages on the order
Talk about the order where it lives. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
Documents linked together

When something is wrong

faq: Can a supplier deliver in several parts?
Yes. Each part has its delivery note and the customer confirms what arrived. The order stays open until everything is in.
Who can see an order’s messages?
The people working on the order at both businesses. A message goes out only when you press Send.
Do orders follow approval rules?
Yes. Your business decides who approves which orders, and the order waits until they do.

finance-administration.description: Invoice from orders with the right VAT for each country, receive invoices read by AI from a file or by e-mail, and see what is due and overdue in one list.

hero.title: Invoices that check themselves against the order.
hero.lede: Issue invoices from your orders with VAT by country and the wording the law requires. Invoices you receive, by e-mail, as a file or on SELYVO, are read by AI and matched to their order before you approve them.

features.title: Less retyping, fewer surprises
items: VAT by country
The rate, the reverse charge or the exemption for the two countries, and the legal wording for each case.
Invoices by e-mail
Suppliers send invoices to invoice@market.selyvo.com. AI reads each one, finds your business and the order, and asks the sender for anything missing.
Invoices from a file
Drop a PDF and AI reads the supplier, the lines, the VAT and the totals for you to check.
Without a purchase order, within your rules
Accept invoices without a purchase order from the suppliers you choose, up to the amount you set.
Expenses with receipts
Receipts read by AI, billed on to a customer’s order or kept as your own cost.
Payables, receivables, overdue
One list for both sides, with what is due and what is late.

faq: Can I send invoices made in my own accounting?
Yes. Upload the file: SELYVO reads it and sends it to the customer with its order.
Can we bring our past invoices?
Yes. Your past invoices are read by AI, and their suppliers can be invited to SELYVO.
How is VAT handled across borders?
SELYVO applies the rate, the reverse charge or the exemption that fits the two countries and prints the wording the law requires.

faqAdd: What happens to an invoice that does not match its order?
It waits for you with what the check found. If you choose, it goes back to its supplier by itself, with what to correct, and the corrected invoice takes its place.

faq: Can a customer approve time sheets on SELYVO?
Yes. The customer’s approver sees each time sheet with its days and what was done, and approves it or returns it with a comment.
Do I need MailChat?
No, it is optional. It gives your business a SELYVO mailbox for writing to partners, and your own e-mail address is never shown.
Can freelancers use SELYVO?
Yes. A freelancer joins as a one-person business, by invitation like any other, and works with the same tools.

compliance-by-design.title: Trust and compliance on SELYVO Market
compliance-by-design.description: Members are invited, found in their business register, checked against sanctions lists and qualified before they trade. Every record keeps its history.

hero.title: Know who you deal with, and keep proof of what was agreed.
hero.lede: Every business on SELYVO is invited by a member, found in its register, checked and qualified before it trades. Every record keeps its history: who did what, and when.
hero.shot: Registration: the company found in its business register, confirmed with one click.

features.title: Trust built into every step
items: Invited by a member
No anonymous sign-ups. Every business joins through an invitation from a customer or supplier who is already on SELYVO.
Found in the register
Company ID, address, VAT number and registered activities come from the official business register.
Sanctions checks
Each business is checked against sanctions lists when it joins, before it can trade.
Qualification and questionnaires
SELYVO’s questions with proofs give a first rating. Your own questionnaires go to your suppliers and customers.
Rights and approvals
Each person sees what their role allows. Your approval rules decide who approves orders, time sheets and expenses.
A history for every record
Requests, offers, orders and invoices keep their history: who changed what, and when.

faq: Can we set our own requirements for suppliers?
Yes. Send your own questionnaires with an invitation or a request, and see the answers and their proofs before you decide.
Who sees what inside our business?
Each person sees what their role allows. Amounts and finances are shown only to people with the rights to see them.
What does a partner see of us?
Only what you send or publish: your listings, your offers, your orders and invoices with them, and your profile.

hero.lede: SELYVO Core gives larger organisations their own workspace: suppliers with risk and performance, questionnaires, catalogues and process flows with AI checks, connected to SELYVO Market and to the systems you already run.

features.title: What SELYVO Core adds
items: Suppliers board
Active, preferred, high-risk and onboarding suppliers with the KPIs you choose, and every request to add a supplier in one queue.
Questionnaires
Reusable question sets for onboarding, assessment and ESG, answered by suppliers with proofs and scored.
Request & shop
A catalogue for employees with preferred items, bundles and budgets per cost centre. Requests flow into approval.
Processes with AI checks
Approval flows in which an AI check screens a supplier or a document and returns pass, fail or needs review. A person decides.
Fits your landscape
Run it as integrated SELYVO modules, or as one harmonised interface over the ERP, CRM and procurement systems you keep.
Configured, not coded
Every limit and threshold is set by your operators. Nothing is written into the code.

No. SELYVO Market works on its own. Core is for organisations that want their own processes and workspace.
Can Core run alongside our ERP?
Yes. It can be the system where the work happens, or one interface over the systems you keep.
How do we start?
With one process, such as supplier onboarding or employee purchasing, measured before and after.
